evidence.text: Synthetic study A evaluates lexical retrieval on Dataset Cedar. The paper reports Recall@10 of 42 percent with 100 candidates. The experiment uses a fixed corpus of 1000 passages. Latency is not reported.

evidence.title: Synthetic study B
